feature_descriptions.la: Lines added across all modified files in the commit.
feature_descriptions.ld: Lines deleted across all modified files in the commit.
feature_descriptions.nf: Number of files modified in the commit.
feature_descriptions.nd: Number of directories modified in the commit.
feature_descriptions.ns: Number of top-level subsystems touched by the commit.
feature_descriptions.ent: Shannon entropy (base 2) measuring how diffusely changes are spread across files.
feature_descriptions.ndev: Average number of distinct past developers who previously changed the touched files.
feature_descriptions.age: Average age (in days) since the modified files were last touched.
feature_descriptions.nuc: Average number of prior commits that previously modified the touched files.
feature_descriptions.aexp: Number of prior commits authored by this developer in the repository.

compatibility_table.name: nd
compatibility_table.definition: count(distinct parent directories of modified files)

compatibility_table.name: ns
compatibility_table.definition: count(distinct top-level directories of modified files)

compatibility_table.name: ndev
compatibility_table.definition: mean distinct past authors who previously touched the modified files

compatibility_table.name: age
compatibility_table.definition: mean days between current commit and previous commit touching each file

compatibility_table.name: nuc
compatibility_table.definition: mean count of prior commits that touched each modified file

compatibility_table.name: aexp
compatibility_table.definition: count of prior commits authored by this developer in repository

compatibility_table.name: arexp
compatibility_table.definition: Decayed author experience; exact decay constant not reproducible across tools

compatibility_table.name: asexp
compatibility_table.definition: Author subsystem experience; weighting not reproducible across tools

compatibility_table.name: fix
compatibility_table.definition: Linked to JIRA/GitHub issue tracker; not available at general commit time

compatibility_table.name: author_date
compatibility_table.definition: Used only for time-aware train/val/test splitting, not as model feature

compatibility_table.name: project
compatibility_table.definition: Domain identity feature that prevents cross-project generalization
